70f4c8d9: ;
;DGJSUM procedure
;
;This procedure sums all entrant HealthFactor scores according to
;categpories. It has the following steps:
;
;1. For each health factor/category, find the most recent date
;2. Set all dates other than the most recent date to false
;3. For the most recent date, only the occurrence with the highest
;   WCR can be true. Set all others on that date to false.
;4. Sum the scores of all 'true' health factor occurrences by category.
